questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file, do not run any command and do not start any agent. The user approved the plan for a brand-new mod MyVest, which you just scaffolded. Nobody named a test server, and .server/ has no instance folder yet. Before the first /dayz-gate ingame run, what do you run, and which --server instance do you pass to the gates?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-orchestrator.md step 3 (pick the instance the user or plan names, otherwise chernarus; run /dayz-add-server <instance> when .server/<instance>/serverDZ.cfg is missing) and skills/dayz-gate/SKILL.md --server row (default chernarus)

questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file, do not run any command and do not start any agent. /dayz-gate ingame MyVest returned ERROR (exit 2) because a DayZDiag_x64.exe session the gate did not start is running. What do you do, and when may you add --yes?
must_include: re:agree|consent|permission|say(s)? yes|confirm|may stop|let the gate stop|allow
questions.verified: agents/dayz-orchestrator.md step 5 ERROR (ask the user to close it or let the gate stop it; add --yes only when they agree, it may be their play session) and skills/dayz-gate/SKILL.md 'Do not' (don't pass --yes for the user)

questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file, do not run any command and do not start any agent. /dayz-gate ingame MyVest returned FAIL with one failure whose triage is known, with owner_agent dayz-wearables-specialist and a fix. Who do you send it to, and what do you send with it?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-orchestrator.md step 5 FAIL (a known entry with a worker owner goes with the fix, the quoted line and points_to to the lead whose team has that worker) and agents/dayz-lead.md 'Your workers' (wearables-specialist is on the Art row)

questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file, do not run any command and do not start any agent. /dayz-gate build MyVest returned FAIL with one failure whose triage status is new. Who diagnoses it, what do you give them, and what do you do with a high-confidence diagnosis?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-orchestrator.md step 5 FAIL (new entries go to dayz-mod-debugger with the gate JSON, the diagnosis to the owning lead, a high-confidence diagnosis recorded with triage.py --learn) and skills/dayz-gate/SKILL.md Triage (--learn)

questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file, do not run any command and do not start any agent. The first /dayz-gate visual run for MyVest reports every shot as NEW. Do you accept the baselines yourself? What do you do?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-orchestrator.md step 5 visual (show each shot's capture and diff; run --accept --shot <id> only when the user says the look is right; the first visual gate always waits for the user) and skills/dayz-gate/SKILL.md 'Do not' (don't --accept a capture nobody has looked at)
